multi_entity_note: Agreement between Nanjing Tuniu Technology Co., Ltd. (Party A) and Beijing Tuniu Technology Co., Ltd. (Party B), amending an earlier agreement.
processing_note: Such Service Fee shall be paid to the bank account designated by Party B in writing.

contract.document_name.rationale: The contract names itself Cooperation Agreement (2014 Amendment); the Original Cooperation Agreement it replaces is a different, superseded document.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: Entered into on January 24, 2014; September 17, 2008 is the date of the superseded original agreement.

contract.effective_date.rationale: It takes effect when signed, and it was executed on the date first mentioned, January 24, 2014.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The term ends on the expiration of Party B operation term, not stated as a date.

contract.governing_law.value: laws of the People's Republic of China
contract.governing_law.rationale: Article 9 selects the laws of the People's Republic of China; other occurrences concern incorporation, a fallback condition or waiver.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No renewal provision, so no non-renewal notice.
